mapper.sql: a.sys90_after_service_id AS after_service_id, a.sys90_company_id AS company_id, b.sys01_company_nm AS company_nm, a.sys90_happen_date::date AS happen_date, a.sys90_reg_emp_nm AS reg_emp_nm, a.sys90_type_yn AS type_yn, f_cdnm('AfterServiceCode', a.sys90_type_yn, a.sys90_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS after_service_nm, a.sys90_happen_reason AS happen_reason, regexp_replace(regexp_replace(a.sys90_happen_reason, '<[^>]*>', '', 'g'), E'&#[0-9]+;|&\\w+;', '', 'g') AS organize_happen_reason, a.sys90_happen_remedy AS happen_remedy, a.sys90_state_cd AS state_cd, f_cdnm('AfterStateCode', a.sys90_state_cd, a.sys90_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS after_state_nm, a.sys90_worker AS worker, a.sys90_due_date::date AS due_date, a.sys90_remarks AS remarks, a.sys90_confirm_yn AS confirm_yn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys90_after_service a LEFT OUTER JOIN sys01_company b ON a.sys90_company_id = b.sys01_company_id WHERE a.sys90_after_service_id = #{afterServiceId}
